title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with washed‑out, rough sound still delivers a terrific, colorfully imaginative second set.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the performance highly, praising the second set for its astounding color and imagination despite the recording’s “shitty washed out” quality and occasional rough spots. The audience source captures the band’s fun energy, making it a worthwhile listen even though the tape is an nth‑generation copy with limited fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews highlight a strong show (especially the second set) but note poor recording quality, leading to an overall solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape is rough in spots and described as a washed‑out nth‑generation copy; sound is low‑fidelity but not enough to detract from the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set receives particular praise for its imaginative playing and high energy; overall show is deemed terrific despite lack of specific song mentions.

band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for playing electric bass guitar with notable presence.
